redraws.label: Factory
redraws.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached enlarged pixel reference of a legacy Factorio Yuoki PFW inventory icon (original 32x32 pixels). Primary request: create a conservative AI-assisted higher-resolution redraw of exactly this icon for comparison with a conventional 2x upscale. Subject: A compact industrial ammunition factory viewed isometrically: tall cylindrical dark steel processing tower at left/rear, dense mechanical pipes and orange/copper details, squat adjoining production units at right/front. Carefully preserve the original arrangement, footprint, perspective, silhouette, colors and highlight direction. Style: faithfully match the original gritty pre-rendered industrial game art; refine ambiguous pixel edges and small surfaces enough to read at 64x64, without redesigning the object. Composition: one object only, square canvas, retain the reference object's relative canvas occupancy and center; keep a small transparent margin. Background: genuine transparency. Constraints: preserve the object identity and original orientation; no labels, text, border, checkerboard drawn into the image, new props, ground plane, dramatic glow or cast shadow outside the object. This is one sample icon, not a sheet or comparison panel.
